blocks.x: Who did the arrangements on that one?
The band is conducted by Bob Belden.
Did they do “Fly with the Wind” again? Was Slide on that one?
Yeah, “Fly with the Wind,” Slide is on it.
Say again? Conductor was Bob Belden and then on “Angle Eyes” Slide Hampton conducted that one.
Slide had a lot of good arrangements.
So you had Virgil Jones, Steve Turre, Frank Lacy, John Clark, so again, truly a big band, you even got Junior Cook . . . John Stubblefield, Joe Ford, so you brought in-
